cases.name: Jessica Briggs
cases.about: She was part of a group of teenagers who lived on the streets.
cases.narrative: Her throat had been slashed, severing the carotid artery and puncturing her jugular vein. She had been stabbed multiple times and nearly disemboweled after her death and her body was found floating off the Portland waterfront.

cases.name: Sokha Khuon
cases.about: Her obituary said Sokha was truly a sweet person with a great personality. She was known to be outgoing and had a great sense of humor. She loved spending time with her children, friends and families. She loved to cook and was always looking for new recipes. She was a favorite in her circle of friends and family and especially dear to her nieces and nephew. She cared about everyone and was known as Auntie to most. Sokha worked hard while raising her children. Her hobbies included gardening, fishing and cooking. She loved planting new flowers, fruit plants and vegetables. Some of her favorite memories were attending the high school games of her two oldest children. She loved going to her daughter’s basketball and softball games, and her sons wrestling.
cases.narrative: Shot multiple times in head & neck while standing & after she fell.
